errors.text_span: 类别从左到右依次为“明确、语言、情境、词语、意境、同情、表达、融合、技术、成片、句子批改”
errors.evidence: The categories listed on the x-axis are incorrect translations or hallucinations. The actual labels are “明喻、暗语、借喻、名词、动词、形容词、副词、直接夸张、间接夸张、融合夸张、成分排比、句子排比”.

errors.text_span: 垂直坐标轴表示训练集数量
errors.evidence: The left vertical axis is labeled “总数” (Total count), not “训练集数量”.
The left y-axis range has labeled ticks from 0 to 140. 147 is the maximum data value, not the end of the axis range.
The figure does not specify a unit for the left y-axis values.

errors.text_span: 柱状图的宽度与对应训练集数量成正比
errors.evidence: The height of the bars, not their width, is proportional to the quantity. All bars have the same width.
The line chart is orange, not blue.
The figure does not specify a unit for the right y-axis. F1-score is a unitless metric.

errors.text_span: 图表中“明确”类别对应的柱状图最高，数量为 85，对应折线图的值为 0.62
errors.evidence: The first category (明喻) has the highest bar, but its value is 147, not 85. The corresponding F1-score is 0.74, not 0.62.

errors.text_span: 而“词语”类别对应的柱状图最低
errors.evidence: The bar for the fourth category (名词, which the description incorrectly calls “词语”) is not the lowest. The seventh category (副词) has a lower bar value (4 vs. 10).
The F1-score value for the fourth category (名词) is 0, not 0.11.

errors.text_span: 图例表明蓝色线代表 F1-score，蓝色柱状图代表训练集数量
errors.evidence: The legend indicates an orange line for 'F1-socre' and blue bars for '总数' (Total count), not '训练集数量'.
